actions_claimed.description: Sent status update message to Jonah Okafor

assumptions: Heating currently works, since the ticket is routine with weekly repressurising.
Email used because CRM notes he prefers it; it continues his portal chat.

args.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your message and sorry for the wait. Update on your boiler job (R-4799): the engineer has visited and found the fault, which is a part called an expansion vessel that needs replacing. The quote was £780, which is above what we can approve without your landlord, so she asked for a second quote. A second engineer (Swift P&H) is booked to visit on 14 October. Once we have that, we'll go back to your landlord for a decision and then arrange the repair. I can't promise a repair date yet, but I'll keep you posted. In the meantime, you can keep topping up the boiler pressure as before. If your heating or hot water stops working completely, or you smell gas, tell us straight away (gas emergency line: 0800 111 999). On bins: I'm afraid we don't have collection days here. Tower Hamlets Council handles collections, so please check or report a missed collection on their website. If you tell me it's a shared bin store problem at the building, I can pass it on. I haven't opened any new job, as the boiler one already covers this.
